
###  Cod, Eelpout and Perch

```{r, echo = FALSE}
# Base path for HARSAT output (figures & tables). Set from generate_appendix.R via
# options(appendix.base_path = ...).
base_path <- getOption("appendix.base_path")
```

#### Summary statistics

```{r, results = "asis", echo = FALSE}
fish_table_path <- file.path(base_path, "tables", "{{var}}_fish_table.csv")
if (file.exists(fish_table_path)){
  read_csv(fish_table_path) %>%
    #filter(((Species == "Perch") & (`Sampling site` %in% c("Kvädöfjärden", "Örefjärden", "Holmöarna")))| (Species != "Perch")) %>% 
    kable("latex", booktabs = TRUE, escape = FALSE, align = c(rep("l", 2), rep("r", 14)),
          caption = paste(tex("{{var_name}}"), "in Cod, Eelpout and Perch.", tab_caption("{{var}}"))) %>%
    add_header_above(c(" "=5, "Whole time period"=6, "Last 10 years"=2)) %>% 
    kable_styling(latex_options = c("scale_down", "hold_position"))
} else
{
  print(paste(fish_table_path, "is missing"))
  
}
```


#### Station time-series

```{r, fig.width = 4, out.width = "0.33\\textwidth", fig.asp= 1.3, echo = FALSE}
figs_dir <- file.path(base_path, "figs")
plot_files_GADU <- dir(figs_dir) %>% 
  subset(., str_detect(., "GADU_{{var}}.pdf")) %>% 
  order_figs()
plot_files_ZOAR <- dir(figs_dir) %>% 
  subset(., str_detect(., "ZOAR_{{var}}.pdf")) %>% 
  order_figs()
plot_files_PERC <- dir(figs_dir) %>% 
  subset(., str_detect(., "PERC_{{var}}.pdf")) %>% 
  order_figs()
plot_files <- file.path(figs_dir, c(plot_files_GADU, plot_files_ZOAR, plot_files_PERC)) %>% 
  subset(., file.exists(.))
knitr::include_graphics(plot_files)
```
